spoken_first_2s: यह मैं हूं 44 साल का 5 फीट 8 इंच लंबा 85

notes.hook: exact starting numbers in the first line ('44 saal, 5 feet 8 inch, 85 kilo')
notes.what_goes_wrong: Seconds 24-33 repeat the pledge ('six pack bana ke rahunga') instead of showing day 5's actual workout; the series promise is strong, the proof is missing.
notes.reusable_pattern: State your exact starting numbers in the first line and make a public day-by-day promise; 'phir milte hain kal' turns one reel into a series.
